aggregation_stories.title: Fertilizer Deal With Belarus Is In the Works, Says Trump. CF Industries and Nutrien Stocks Fall.
aggregation_stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced that the U.S. is negotiating a deal with Belarus to acquire potash, a crucial fertilizer component, at reduced prices. Following this announcement, shares of major fertilizer companies CF Industries (CF) and Nutrien (NTR) experienced a decline. The potential deal aims to lower fertilizer costs, impacting the market for existing suppliers.
